## Episode Thesis

This is a political Friday panel with Anna Kinberg Batra and Daniel Suhonen, 23 days before the Swedish election. They discuss government-formation scenarios, how strong the Centre Party's position is, and the ISK savings-account tax debate. Kinberg Batra argues that ISK has helped build a strong venture-capital market for small caps. Suhonen argues for higher taxes on passive capital and billionaires, and for an active industrial policy. Very little is said about markets or specific stocks, and no investment calls are made.
